# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues via GitHub Security Advisories:
https://github.com/amir-the-h/virtual-cameraman/security/advisories/new

If you cannot use the advisory workflow, open a private discussion or issue with minimal details and we will follow up.

We will acknowledge receipt, assess the report, and coordinate a fix and disclosure timeline.
